clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 4 (L-1336). Does any system call, precompile or fee path hold or credit a native balance after genesis on Tempo (4217).
clearedSpotChecks.note: web3_clientVersion on https://rpc.mainnet.tempo.xyz returned tempo/v1.19.2-c0c9372/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu at block 0x30ca6a5. eth_getBalance of the PoolManager returned the placeholder 0x9612...c9b2, which carries no information. An eth_call with a code override running SELFBALANCE at the PoolManager address returned 0, and a call running BALANCE on the PoolManager returned 0, so the EVM sees no native balance. config.rs at c0c9372 lines 497, 544, 551, 558 and 562-568 refuse any transaction with nonzero value (ValueTransferNotAllowed). In src/PoolManager.sol:349-354 a native settle credits msg.value, which is then always 0, and the native take in src/types/Currency.sol:44-52 is a value call that fails without a balance. No native credit can be created from nothing.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Who gains from credits the PoolManager accrues: the TIP-1060 credits and refunds move only gas, and no other account can switch the PoolManager's mode.
clearedSpotChecks.note: settle_storage_credit_refunds (config.rs:444-487 at c0c9372) runs only for a successful T7 transaction. It reads the transient map of 0x1060..00, lowers the persistent credit word and passes the result only to result.gas.record_refund. It writes no PoolManager slot and no token balance. storage_credits/mod.rs:169-193 keys set_mode and set_budget by msg_sender. The PoolManager calls only hooks, token contracts and native recipients, never the credit precompile with itself as sender, so only a hook could ask it to, and a hook calls as itself. The extra 245,000 gas per slot creation in Refund mode can make a call with a tight gas limit run out of gas. That is a gas estimation matter for the caller and moves no funds.
